<thought>Search for a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to amide bond formation (break aliphatic carboxylic acid, form C‑N amide). Use bond codes 6‑7 for C‑N formed and 6‑8 for C‑O broken.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
  "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
  "bonds_formed": ["6-7"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
